text: Entry Requirements 1. Status Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China, hold a valid passport or citizenship certificate from their own countries for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence outside of China for more than 2 years within the recent 4 years (before April 30 of the year prior to admission). Note that actual residence outside of China for 9 months or more in a year may be counted as 1 year, based on the dates of the entry and exit stamps on the passport. 2. General Application Requirements (1) Generally, applicants shall be aged 20 or below. (2) Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have good moral character and no record of bad behaviour, and abide by China's laws and regulations and the University's rules and regulations. (3) Applicants must have sufficient financial resources to support their studies and living in China. (4) Applicants must have completed their high school studies and been awarded a high school diploma or a higher qualification. Applicants must have chosen the science stream in their high school studies, which, besides Mathematics and English language, should comprise pure science subjects like Biology, Chemistry and Physics. The admission criteria are detailed below: (5) In general, the applicants should be graduating from high school in the current year of the intended university enrollment, with good academic and behaviour records at school. (6) For international students under the age of 18 whose parents are not ordinarily residing in China, the parents must formally appoint a foreigner or a Chinese citizen who is ordinarily residing in China as the guardian for the international student, and provide supporting documents.
